desc: Play as: pronouns follow the pick where the text names Mario (TTYD_PLAY_AS_PRONOUN_TEST=1): Peach's are hers in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Japanese (he/she, his/her/hers, er/sie, sein/ihr, il/elle, el/ella, lui/lei, kare/kanojo); spoken to ('Mario, he...'), the pick's own name, French's impersonal il and German's 'sein' (to be) stay; Luigi's stay his
